{{Top|leg}}
'''Llians, llans''' or '''llian beasts''' were large creatures found on [[Orsis]]. They had spined tails and tended to be solitary, although they could be tamed by [[magick]], as demonstrated by the [[Nightsisters]]. A young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] encountered four of them when about to complete the Gora. They were being used as mounts by [[Talzin]] and her witches.<ref name="TWoDM2">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref><ref name="TWoDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Continuity==
In a short story "[[Restraint]]" by [[James Luceno]] which was published in [[December 27]], [[2011]] these creatures are named as llans, however in a junior novel ''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]'' by [[Ryder Windham]], which came out only five days later in [[January 1]], [[2012]], they were named as llians. It's unknown, whether it was a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]], or just a misspell.
